content:
**pure drawer parsers and the layout module land for #881**

layout.mjs (DFS back-edge reversal, longest-path layering, 4-sweep barycentre ordering, deterministic/cycle-tolerant per R881-7), colour.mjs (exhaustive roadmap-state/node-status to CSS-class map, D9-note), spec-cards.mjs (spec.md's requirement/scenario grammar), tasks-list.mjs (tasks.md checklist grammar, attribution injected from blame.mjs rather than fetched), blame.mjs (pure git-blame-porcelain parser), and resume-view.mjs (shapes parsed resume.md frontmatter, no validateResume gate) land in brain/scripts/ui/lib/, each with a source-carrying drawer field (A3) and a colocated test. change-route.mjs (the one IO file in this slice) is deferred to a follow-up run of PR 3 — this batch was scoped to lib/** only. watcher.mjs now imports parseWorktrees from the lane collector instead of a diverging copy.
